seo.title: Columbia Beach Resort Pissouri Cyprus: Honeymoon (2026)
seo.description: Quiet 5-star villa resort between Paphos and Limassol. Score 86/100, from €350/night. Best villa, 7-night plan, real cost, honest 2026 verdict, email.

content.verdict: Columbia Beach Resort is the all-villa property at Pissouri Bay — a small horseshoe cove exactly halfway between Paphos and Limassol that delivers the quietest 5-star resort experience in southern Cyprus. The defining feature is the format: every accommodation is a freestanding villa or suite-villa with a private terrace, set into a low-rise village around a single 80m freshwater pool that meets the sand at one end. No mid-rise blocks, no corridors — the property reads more like a Greek-island village than a Cypriot resort. Pissouri Bay itself is the quietest swimmable cove on the south coast: a 1km arc of golden sand and shingle, calm sheltered water, and a clutch of small tavernas along the beach road. Columbia is the right choice for honeymooners who want a quieter, more village-scale alternative to the Limassol urban-beach strip — with the Paphos UNESCO sites 30 minutes west and the Limassol Old Town 35 minutes east, both within reach for day trips without sacrificing the quiet base.
content.best_room: Junior Suite Sea View — the villa category directly on the front row with a sea-view terrace, walking distance to the sand, and the most generous bath of the entry suites. For higher budgets, the Royal Senior Suite adds a separate living room and a larger terrace. The Standard Garden View villas lose the property's headline (the bay view), so book Sea View specifically.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Arrival at Paphos or Larnaca
itinerary_7_nights.description: Paphos (PFO) is 35 minutes west, Larnaca (LCA) is 75 minutes east — both work. Columbia welcome at the lobby fountain, villa familiarisation, sunset at the Bacchus Bar overlooking the bay. First dinner at Apollo (the resort's fine-dining Mediterranean restaurant).

itinerary_7_nights.title: Pissouri Bay Reset
itinerary_7_nights.description: Late breakfast at the Capers terrace, morning by the 80m pool, beach walk along the full Pissouri crescent. Lunch at Kostas Tavern on the beach road (the local choice for grilled fish). Afternoon at the Hebe Spa, evening at Bacchus.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Pafos UNESCO Mosaics
itinerary_7_nights.description: Drive 35 minutes west to Paphos — the Archaeological Park mosaics, the Tombs of the Kings, lunch at Vasilikon in the old harbour. Continue 5 minutes south to Petra tou Romiou (Aphrodite's Rock) on the way back for the sunset swim. Return to Columbia for dinner.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Limassol Old Town Day Trip
itinerary_7_nights.description: Drive 35 minutes east to Limassol — the medieval castle, the carob warehouses, halloumi tastings, meze flight at Karatello. Continue to the Limassol Marina for sunset cocktails. Return to Pissouri for a late dinner at Apollo.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Spa Day and Pool Rest
itinerary_7_nights.description: Full rest day at Columbia — late breakfast, 90-minute couples massage at the Hebe Spa, afternoon by the pool. Sunset cocktails on the suite terrace, dinner at Bacchus with the sommelier's commandaria pairing.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Akamas Peninsula Day
itinerary_7_nights.description: Drive 90 minutes northwest to Latchi for a half-day Akamas boat trip — Blue Lagoon swim, hidden coves, lunch on board. Return to Columbia by 7pm for a final dinner at Apollo.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Departure
itinerary_7_nights.description: Final breakfast at Capers, last beach swim, 35-minute transfer back to PFO or 75-minute to LCA. Columbia checkout is reliable for late afternoon flights.

caveats: Columbia is family-friendly with a kids club — the main pool can fill with families in July and August. Book a Sea View Junior Suite for the more secluded front-row position; there is no adults-only zone.

Pissouri Bay is genuinely small and quiet — there are 6 tavernas in the village above and that is the dining scene. Couples wanting a city dimension should split with Limassol or Paphos for 2–3 nights.
The beach is golden-sand-and-shingle (better than the Paphos grey-pebble, less good than Latchi's pure golden sand). Most guests use both the beach and the pool freely.

faqs.question: Good for honeymooners?
faqs.answer: Yes — Columbia is the quietest 5-star in southern Cyprus, ideal for honeymooners who prioritise the village-scale resort over urban-beach. Junior Suite Sea View is the right honeymoon category; the all-villa format means more privacy than the mid-rise Limassol or Paphos hotels.

faqs.question: Best time to visit?
faqs.answer: May, June, September, and October are ideal. Columbia operates year-round and is one of the best warm-winter Cypriot options (Pissouri Bay is south-facing and sheltered, with mild winter sun). July and August are hot and family-busy.

faqs.question: Book in advance?
faqs.answer: Sea View Junior Suites book 4 months ahead for the July–September peak. May–June and October typically have flexibility within 2 months. Mention honeymoon at booking — Columbia is consistent with welcome gifts and suite upgrades when available.

faqs.question: Adults-only?
faqs.answer: No — Columbia is a family-friendly resort with no adults-only zone. Couples wanting strict adults-only should book Almyra (Kyma) or Parklane (Edra) instead. Columbia\'s appeal is the quiet bay rather than the adults-only programming.

faqs.question: Best room type?
faqs.answer: Junior Suite Sea View — the front-row villa-suite category with direct bay-view terrace. The Royal Senior Suite is the higher-budget upgrade with a separate living room.

faqs.question: How to get there?
faqs.answer: Paphos International (PFO) is 35 minutes by private transfer (€50–€70 each way) — the closest airport. Larnaca International (LCA) is 75 minutes east (€90–€120). Columbia arranges all transfers.
